'''Mathiren''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mathiren was first introduced as a Flashpoint Vendor in Game Update 2.7 for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''.<ref name="TOR" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
